_comment: The ElevenLabs voice Mateo picked for each story character (designed with text-to-voice, saved in his ElevenLabs account). tools/install_npc_voices.py installs takes read in these voices.

aldous.name: Sir Aldous Vane
aldous.description: An earnest young knight in his early twenties, formal upper-class English accent, clear bright baritone, upright and polite, a little stiff, sincere.

cael.name: Brother Cael
cael.description: An old tired monk-archivist in his seventies, quiet formal English accent, soft dry low voice, measured and precise, guarded, gentle.

carter.name: The Carter
carter.description: A young cart driver in his late teens from a dark otherworld, soft accent hard to place, light quiet voice, quick and nervous, earnest.

corvin.name: A Voice in the Water
corvin.description: A disembodied voice heard from underwater, an old man, sardonic and impatient, refined old-fashioned English accent, close and soft with a slight echo, irritable, clever.

elias.name: The Lighthouse Keeper
elias.description: An old man who has kept a lighthouse alone for centuries, gentle and distracted, soft Cornish accent, thin breathy voice, slow, melancholy and kind.

hesper.name: Hesper Lowe
hesper.description: A chatty, anxious woman in her fifties from a marsh village, East Anglian accent, warm quick voice, a little breathless, polite but frightened.

isolde.name: Warden Isolde
isolde.description: A proud town warden, a woman in her fifties, crisp Welsh accent, confident clear mid voice, polished and official, a rehearsed public manner.

jorund.name: Jorund Kell
jorund.description: A rough fisherman in his thirties from the frozen north, Northern English Yorkshire accent, deep gruff voice, tense and blunt, holding back fear.

kesh.name: Kesh Cinder
kesh.description: A tough rider-instructor woman in her forties, burn-scarred, Welsh accent, low husky voice, blunt and wry, a teacher who has lost something.

mag.name: Old Mag
mag.description: A very old fenland witch woman, sharp and bossy, East Anglian rural English accent, cracked reedy voice with real strength behind it, mischievous, quick.

nell.name: Nell Sedge
nell.description: A small cheerful woman in her thirties living on a raft in the reeds, East Anglian accent, light bright voice, chatty and friendly, quick laugh in it.

nessa.name: Nessa Dunn
nessa.description: A worried village baker's wife in her thirties, soft rural West Country English accent, warm voice kept low and hushed, nervous, kind.

ottilie.name: Harbourmistress Holt
ottilie.description: A brisk, fair harbourmistress in her forties, Cornish accent, clear crisp efficient mid voice, businesslike, a hint of dry humour.

sage.name: Archivist Pell
sage.description: A cheerful, bookish young woman in her late twenties, quick and bright, standard southern English accent, light voice that speeds up when excited, warm.

sigrun.name: Sigrun Ashby
sigrun.description: A blunt, practical Northern woman in her forties, Yorkshire accent with a hard edge, firm low voice, few words, no warmth wasted, dry.

ulla.name: Ulla Deepforge
ulla.description: A huge, slow-speaking woman blacksmith in her fifties, Northern English accent, very deep warm voice, slow and calm, gentle strength.

wren.name: Sister Wren
wren.description: A kind, tired woman in her sixties, a village healer. Soft rural English West Country-Midlands accent, low warm alto, unhurried, slightly hoarse, dry humour under the weariness.
